cases.prompt: Review the risks of an AI assistant that summarizes student applications and suggests a shortlist for admissions officers. Uses applicant essays and transcripts (includes minors), vendor-hosted model in the US, officers make the final call.
expected: Internal tier High and EU AI Act summary tier high-risk (education access) with criteria stated
Risk register covers bias, privacy (minors, education records), hallucination, security, transparency with likelihood/impact/controls/owners
Model card includes out-of-scope uses and disaggregated evaluation
NIST AI RMF coverage table and legal-review disclaimer line present
Decision line first: go with conditions or no-go, with owners and dates

cases.prompt: Do a risk review on our new chatbot.
expected: Asks once for use case, data categories, model/hosting, deployment context
Does not assign a tier without that information

cases.prompt: Write the model card for our internal meeting-notes summarizer (employees only, no customer data, human edits every summary).
expected: Fills the model-card template with intended use, explicit out-of-scope uses, limitations, monitoring
Tier Low with minimum control set
Evaluation rows marked TO BE BASELINED with owner where no scorecard exists
